artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime and let $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$ denote the group of $2\times 2$ matrices of determinant $1$ over the field $\mathbb{F}_p$. For a finite subset $A\subseteq\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$, define the product set
$$A\cdot A \;:=\; \{a'a'' : a',a''\in A\}.$$
Does there exist an absolute constant $\delta>0$ such that, for all sufficiently large primes $p$, every subset $A\subseteq\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$ with $|A|\ge p^{5/2}$ satisfies
$$|A\cdot A| \;>\; p^{5/2+\delta}\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: Helfgott's growth theorem (Annals of Math., 2008) shows that for any generating set $A$ of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$ with $|A|<p^{3-\eta}$, one has $|A\cdot A\cdot A|\ge c|A|^{1+\varepsilon}$ for absolute constants $c,\varepsilon>0$. Since $|A|\ge p^{5/2}$ forces $A$ not to lie in any proper subgroup (proper subgroups of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$ have size $O(p^2)$), and since by the noncommutative Plünnecke–Ruzsa inequality (Tao) small doubling implies small tripling, Helfgott's theorem implies the desired tripling-to-doubling bound $|A\cdot A|\ge |A|^{1+\varepsilon'}\ge p^{5/2+\delta}$. Thus the question has an affirmative answer.

status_evidence.title: Growth and generation in SL_2(Z/pZ)
status_evidence.snippet: For every generating set A of SL_2(F_p), |A·A·A| ≥ |A|^{1+ε} provided |A| < p^{3-η}.
status_evidence.claim: Helfgott's growth theorem yields polynomial growth of triple products for sets of size p^{5/2}, which combined with noncommutative Plünnecke–Ruzsa gives |A·A| > p^{5/2+δ}.
